config.statement:
The natural numbers $p, q$ are such that for every real number $x$

$$
(x+1)^{{p}}(x-3)^{{q}}=x^{{n}}+a_{{1}} x^{{n-1}}+a_{{2}} x^{{n-2}}+\cdots+a_{{n-1}} x+a_{{n}},
$$

where $n=p+q$ and $a_{{1}}, \ldots, a_{{n}}$ are real numbers. There are infinitely many pairs $(p, q)$ for which $a_{{1}}=a_{{2}}$. Exhibit ${N}$ such pairs.
config.formatting_instructions: Output the sequences as a list of comma-separated tuples inside of \boxed, e.g. \boxed{[(2, 19), (3, 123)]}.
config.source: Bulgarian Spring National Competition 2022 10-12th Grade P3
